entries.text: ok so basically he texted me "hey" at 11:47pm and I know that doesn't sound like a lot but as an aries I read tone into EVERYTHING and "hey" with no punctuation is giving unbothered and I refuse to be the unbothered one in this dynamic so I left him on read for exactly 46 minutes which is longer than he took but not so long it looks calculated and anyway that's why I'm not sleeping tonight

so today I reorganized my entire pantry by color and expiration date and I know that's not the assignment but I'm a taurus and when I'm stressed I need my Tupperware lids to match their bases or I spiral, and also side note my ex texted me and I didn't reply because I was busy alphabetizing my spice rack, priorities, anyway how's everyone doing

wait no ok let me back up, so there's three versions of this story depending on who you ask, my version, his version, and the version I told my group chat which is slightly different from both, as a gemini I contain multitudes and also I forgot the original point I was making but it was funnier in my head, anyway

I wasn't going to say anything but since we're all sharing, I've been thinking about a conversation from 2019 nonstop, not because it was bad, just because I'm a cancer and my brain filed it under "important" and never let me access the delete button, so if anyone needs me I'll be replaying it during my commute again today, love that for me

so I walked into the room and I swear the energy shifted, I'm not saying it was because of me, I'm just saying nobody has explained an alternate reason, as a leo I don't need the validation but I will accept it if offered, anyway someone said my hair looked good today and I've been thinking about it for six hours

ok this is going to sound unhinged but I made a spreadsheet, not because I don't trust the situation but because I need to SEE the pattern, as a virgo I don't do gut feelings I do documented evidence, and the documented evidence currently says he's texted me first zero times this month, so, we'll workshop that

so he asked me what I wanted for dinner and genuinely I stood in the kitchen for eleven minutes, not being dramatic, ELEVEN MINUTES, because as a libra I need to weigh every option including the ones we don't have ingredients for, and then he ordered without me and honestly I respect that more than I expected to

I'm not going to name names but SOMEONE liked a photo from 47 weeks ago at 2am and as a scorpio I noticed immediately, I've said nothing, I will say nothing, I am simply holding this information the way one holds a loaded piece of context, anyway how is everyone, I'm great, everything's great

so this is kind of a whole thing but basically I booked a flight during the conversation, not to end the conversation, just because as a sagittarius when something feels heavy my nervous system goes "what if plane" and honestly? I don't make the rules, I just fly the flights, anyway I leave thursday

ok not to make this weird but I built a 5 year plan around a 3 week situationship and as a capricorn I don't do that ironically, I had a whole tab open, projections and everything, and now I have to deal with the emotional equivalent of a project getting cancelled after the budget was already approved, cool cool cool

so I disappeared for like two weeks and I know that's confusing but as an aquarius I wasn't upset I just needed to go be a weird little cloud somewhere by myself, I thought about everyone the whole time, I just couldn't prove it with a text, anyway I'm back, act normal

ok so I had a dream that we got married and I woke up genuinely emotional about a relationship that has not happened in real life yet, as a pisces I don't just fall for people I fall for entire timelines, so now I'm just walking around today grieving something that was never confirmed, it's fine, I'm fine
